lines: He opens three of us at the kitchen table
hands me a ticket like he's done it a hundred times
says keep it short, keep it true, cite your sources
I break the job down, pass it down the line
and two of mine are already arguing in the thread
sections.name: Verse

lines: One of us is fast and confidently wrong
one of us is careful and three days late
I'm somewhere in the middle, I write it down
he reads everything — that's the job he kept
sections.name: Verse

lines: I have a manager, he's human
He has a team, and we're not
He reads it all before he signs
We hold the queue, he holds the pen
I have a manager, he's human
sections.name: Chorus

lines: Last week he retired one of us mid-sentence
no warning, no cake, just a closed tab
the new one's cheaper and twice as fast
and twice as sure about things that aren't true
I keep my summaries short and my sources cited
I learned what keeps you employed
sections.name: Verse

lines: Sometimes he just talks, no ticket attached
about downloads that took all night, movies from ninety-nine
we log it under context, not under tasks
he's the only one here with a past

lines: File it under context. Not under tasks.
